description: Observes public documents without modifying their source. Execution can charge USDC or prepaid credits, consume trial quota and update Fresh402 records. A new charge requires prior spending authorization. Without billing/trial credentials, a valid call returns an unpaid quote without executing the observation. Use for bounded directional OpenAPI3.0/3.1 JSON contract-change evidence, including supported paths/operations, required fields, types/enums/null and authentication. Use exactly one real watch_id from free unfiltered registration or contracts:{before,after} serialized JSON strings (24,000 characters each/48,000 combined UTF-8 bytes). Supplied pairs compare before to after without a fetch or saved watch; omit comparison overrides. Same price and original-operation recovery. Stored mode has no URL override. compare_to: previous(default) or baseline; previous_hash overrides with supported retained evidence. First stored-watch call seeds contract history; explicit pairs compare immediately and return a conservative CI verdict. No YAML, external-reference fetch or endpoint execution; uncertainty requires review, not a complete compatibility proof. Save and reuse watch IDs across sessions. For a complete single-charge server workflow, use API Compatibility Review when advertised. Rules v3 adds finite numeric/exclusive integer bounds, scalar const in3.1, scalar-item array cardinality and otherwise-identical boolean object closure. Unsupported constraint interactions remain review_required. Optional review contains stable finding IDs, affected operations, bounded excerpts and CI0/1/2; no customer-code inspection or release-safety guarantee. $0.020 USDC/call on Base (eip155:8453), including cache hits. Needs an x402-capable MCP payment client and funded native-USDC payer; ordinary MCP returns a payment challenge. Optional MPP (root mpp_payments.enabled): mppx, org.paymentauth/credential. Prepaid: X-Fresh402-API-Key plus params._meta["fresh402/prepaid"] {idempotency_key,tariff_version,max_credits}; inspect authenticated quote. Choose one billing method; never auto-pay. Persist original proof/input/private recovery token; recover originals after uncertainty. Circle only if root circle_gateway.enabled. Clients, limits and recovery: https://fresh402.com/docs#payments. Free signed trial: /v3/agent-trial requires an unfunded EOA ownership signature; human Web trial: /v2/trial. Eligibility/capacity may return429. Use only X-Fresh402-Trial-Key plus persisted Idempotency-Key; replay exact tool/input/key. Exhaustion never authorizes a charge. The same fixed x402 service price may also be paid in native Circle USDC on Solana Mainnet (solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp), when advertised by the unpaid challenge. Explicitly select one accepted network and pin its mint, merchant, amount and sponsored fee payer before signing. Solana payers need no Base wallet; MPP remains Base-only. Payment network does not change the observed chain: blockchain products still inspect finalized Base. Solana delivery requires finalized matching USDC evidence. Persist the original network, resource, input, proof and private recovery capability; never switch networks or authorize a replacement after uncertainty.

inputSchema.description: Compare exactly one registered watch or an explicit contracts:{before,after} pair. Stored mode preserves previous/baseline/hash behavior. Supplied mode uses before to after, no fetch, no watch mutation or saved observation; omit comparison overrides. Same existing fixed price and original-operation recovery. Bounded document evidence, not live compatibility proof.

compare_to.description: Optional mode: 'previous' (default) compares with the latest saved OpenAPI Contract Diff snapshot; 'baseline' uses its fixed saved baseline. Before contract history exists, the current registered watch state seeds the initial baseline. previous_hash overrides the mode. 'hash' appears only in results, not as an accepted input mode.

contracts.description: Explicit CI comparison, exclusive with a stored source/watch. Combined contract text <=48,000 UTF-8 bytes; the complete HTTP/MCP envelope still has its existing 65,536-byte ceiling. References are resolved locally only. Zero source fetches and no saved watch/observation; the original authorized operation remains durably recoverable.

after.description: New complete JSON OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 contract serialized as a string; at most 24,000 characters. Direction is before to after; source authenticity and deployed API behavior are not verified.

before.description: Old complete JSON OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 contract serialized as a string; at most 24,000 characters. No YAML, URLs, executed code or remote-reference fetching.

previous_hash.description: Optional 64-character hexadecimal reference hash, case-insensitive. Prefer a hash returned by OpenAPI Contract Diff for this same watch, matching a retained contract snapshot or fixed baseline. The current registered core hash is also accepted as a fallback: without a matching contract snapshot, the fixed baseline (or registered state if no baseline exists) is used. Overrides compare_to; unavailable hashes return 404. Omit to use the selected mode.

watch_id.description: Existing watch ID: 'w_' plus 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Required unless contracts is supplied; these inputs are exclusive. Obtain it with free Register using the public JSON OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 URL and no selector or ignore rules. Reuses the saved URL. No URL override, YAML or scoped/filtered watches.
